narrative_explanation.full_narrative:
The hybrid screening model categorized this image as NON CANCER with an estimated model confidence of 91.9% (model cancer probability: 8.1%).

The model's decision was guided predominantly by the Vision Transformer visual branch (67.8% attribution share), indicating that localized visual patch textures exerted stronger influence than spatial-semantic graph relationships.

The model's output was influenced more strongly by highlighted image regions in the Superior-Central (Top Center) and Superior-Right (Top Right). These visual patches exhibited elevated self-attention in the transformer encoder blocks, while the graph branch assigned greater contribution to topological pathways connecting these areas with surrounding oral tissue.

Explanation stability was verified deterministically; repeated evaluations on identical inputs yielded zero numerical deviation.
